notes.title: Demo update 0.2.6
notes.notes: [p]Updated the game to version 0.2.6[/p][list][*][p]Added options to invert the Y and X axis[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you couldn’t navigate the options menu with a controller unless you used a mouse first[/p][/*][*][p]Added shadow quality option to settings[/p][/*][*][p]Minor gameplay tweak[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update 0.2.5
notes.notes: [p]Updated Demo build to 0.2.5[/p][list][*][p]Made the glow-rod movement a little more dynamic. Reacts to jumping now etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the FOV slider into display settings. I don’t know why I had it in controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a setting to turn tutorial messages off or on.[/p][/*][*][p]If tutorials are on, the first chase will prompt the player to run.[/p][/*][*][p]The monster’s footsteps are also louder in the chase.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item to the Security level as a tease.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly changed inventory art for improved powercells.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a button to the main menu that links to the presskit.[/p][/*][*][p]Footsteps are now louder when landing after jumping/falling instead of sometimes being very quiet even after a long fall.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update 0.2.4
notes.notes: [p]Updated the game to version 0.2.4[/p][p]This update improves the general atmosphere across most of the game, and is the first in a series of planned improvements to the demo.[/p][p]-Big light changes, a few areas completely re-done.[/p][p]-Includes some new props for more varied lighting fixtures.[/p][p]-New audio system added to some areas.[/p][p]-Fixed a light that was only visible with lumen off.[/p][p]-Minor changes to the sounds the first monster makes when spawning.[/p][p]-Tweaked LOD settings on some props. [/p][p][/p]
